splitArchive.method: Own local-header/DEFLATE extraction across joined volume bytes; CRC, length and reported APK SHA all verified. Info-ZIP conversion output failed CRC and was not used.

facts.claim: The outline and minder constructor share modelEditor and setModel of the same document model; switching changes view type.
Mobile constructor enables tidy layout with maxScale 4 and explicit scale levels; only this bundled path is established.
Root children split into consecutive slices and positions merge back by model ID.
Branch weight recursively counts visible leaves; splitIndex selects near half total weight. Summary boundaries can adjust that split.
Normal branch positioning considers neighboring subtree bounds/margins; tidy paths dispatch to tidyRight/tidyLeft strategies.
Summary owns explicit memberIds; creation requires existing consecutive siblings with same parent and rejects duplicate member sets/root member. Not automatic text summarization.
This application renderer constructor forces Pixi Canvas, antialias, autoDensity and resolution. This is not a proven Android performance advantage.
Model stores tree, collapsed state and drilledNodeId; structure enum includes org/tree/timeline variants. Enum names alone do not establish all reachable features.

limitations: Provided formatted copies/manifest mentioned in report were not separately attached; modules were independently parsed by Babel and regenerated for inspection. Generated line numbers differ from the report. Raw byte boundaries and hashes are authoritative.
No native persistence, Android bridge, server sync, entitlement, device timing or exported-image limits verified.
No reference APK, JavaScript module code, UI assets or private upload content published into InkWeft; product algorithms are independently implemented.
